# Mathieu Drouet

> Chief AI, Technology & Product Officer (CATPO) based in Lille, France. Product strategy, technology architecture, AI architecture, agentic systems and hands-on delivery for complex B2B products.

Mathieu Drouet works across Product, Technology and AI. Since May 2026, he has worked freelance as Chief AI, Technology & Product Officer at Lilabs, focused on research and development at the intersection of MusicTech and LiveTech.
